_help: Per-file settings for scripts/publish-work.mjs, keyed by the file name in Exports/Portfolio. title: what the site shows. note: optional one-liner. hero: 'desktop' or 'mobile' makes the file the home page showreel instead of a piece in the grid. trail: hand-picked hero trail frames as '<seconds><s|c|e>' (crop the square from the start, centre or end of the frame's long side); without it the script picks frames itself.
